column2: English   17 = opening cutscene. 1A = boss speeches. 1B = night-time / empty-house messages.
[06]Susa!
[06]This is who the woman|you love really is!
[06]Yukishiro?!|Why are you here?
[06]I'm sorry...|Susa...
[06]I was behind all of it.
[06]I had Yukishiro get close to you,|then had her assaulted|before your eyes.
[06]You flew into a rage,|and your ESP erupted.
[06]You clashed with|the Club Federation,|and your ESP grew stronger.
[06]And then you started|digging into the Nosferatu organization...
[06]and found out that I was|pulling the strings.
[06]I'll give you credit for that!|
But in the end, you and Yukishiro|were nothing but my tools!
[06]Y-you... bastard!![14]っ|[06]Rage! Rage, and become|Susano Oh!
[06]Yes! The world will end,|and a new age will begin!
[06]Behold the birth of|the Demon King "Susano Oh"!
[06]With his terrible power,|Susano Oh laid waste|to the world.
[06]After a desperate struggle,|even humanity's last hope,|the Rangoon, fell...
[06]and vanished without a trace...
[06]|So you came, Susa!|It's me, Aonuma. ▼
[06]Aonuma, the one who assaulted|your precious Yukishiro. ▼
[06]Lord Susano Oh gave me power,|and I grew strong, waiting|for you to show up. ▼
[06]And here, just as|Lord Susano Oh intends,|you'll die by my hand! ▼[06]
[06]The great power of the|universe spoke to me. ▼
[06]It told me to draw power|from Lord Susano Oh...|to gather my strength, ▼
[06]and lie in wait for you,|Lord Susano Oh's other self. ▼
[06]And now you're here!|I'll kill you!! ▼[06]
[06]Welcome, Shingo Susa.|You seem to have defeated a|good many of my servants... ▼
[06]But you cannot defeat me!
[06]For I am the rage in your heart,|a manifestation of you|drawn out by Uryuu! ▼
[06]Now I'll kill you, ▼
[06]and you'll give me the last|of your power! Die! ▼
[06]So at the end of your long|journey, you have met|your destiny at last. ▼
[06]It is said that when the three|come together, the final|battle will begin. ▼
[06]But that battle will never|begin, not in all eternity. ▼
[06]For you have not awakened!|And here you will become|mine before you ever do! ▼
[06]Now vanish,|my other self! ▼
[06]So you've come... ▼|Once I absorb you,|it will all be over,|and evil will win. ▼
[06]It will rule the world,|and humankind will fall|and fade away. ▼
[06]Farewell,|my other self! ▼[06]
